commands.environment: repository .venv, Python 3.12.14, Torch 2.14.1, CPU, torch.set_num_threads(1); no native environment

stable_public_surface.constructor: ContextualMemoryV12(adapter, layout, *, source_identity, feature_provider, lr=1e-3, initialization_seed=17, objective_identity=None, execution_identity='CPU_engineering_unbound')
methods: forward(ids, mask, batch, *, scope, enabled=True, active_sites=None)

work_accounting.request: SourceWorkRequest(operation in {source_tokenize, source_forward}, source_bytes, max_tokens, tokens)
work_accounting.protocol: SourceWorkAccounting.reserve(request) -> token; complete(token, status='completed'|'failed', actual, detail)
work_accounting.amounts: source_tokenize -> source_encodes=1, input_tokens=source_bytes (upper bound); source_forward -> forwards=1, input_tokens=exact token count
work_accounting.no_implicit_fallback: FrozenSourceFeatures requires an accounting provider; missing/rejecting accounting fails before tokenizer or source forward

identity_binding.adapter_contract_digest: sha256 over base_snapshot, geometry, attention implementation, use_cache, regime and exact base_content_sha256; a native operator may attest the verified content via adapter.v12_adapter_content_sha256 or the content_identity keyword, otherwise the backbone is hashed once with bounded temporary storage
identity_binding.tokenizer_contract_digest: sha256 over the tokenizer's immutable identity() mapping
identity_binding.feature_contract_sha256: sha256 over SourceFeatureSpec.identity(); transitively binds the declared original-parameter digest, content-bound source-execution/adapter contract and tokenizer contract
identity_binding.producer_release: complete representation release over producer, order and reader state plus the feature contract; any phi update invalidates durable values
identity_binding.producer_state_release: compressor-only release retained for producer state identity
identity_binding.checkpoint_outer_manifest: strict source/base/feature/adapter/tokenizer/layout contracts, producer/representation/producer-state releases, contains_base_weights=false, original_weights_serialized=false, projection_cache=none, fitting_frozen, feature/task state flags and components_manifest_sha256; mismatch refuses before mutation
identity_binding.cache_invalidation: failed reads evict only records whose row status/scope/revision/text or verified text/value files are invalid; ContextualRecordError identifies a single stale authority failure so a healthy sibling keeps bounded C; buffer-only or parameter mutation clears C and blocks export before any directory is created
identity_binding.release_authority: release manifest source_identity must equal path.source_identity at read, value and batch-validation boundaries (values/validate_batch now take a required source_identity keyword); the pointer is atomically replaced only after the store transaction/accounting commits and provider C is cleared, so a pointer/cache failure leaves the previous generation authoritative; failed release writes release their artifact charge and remove partial bytes
identity_binding.ordering: durable slot order is semantic (source_id, source_epoch, source_order) with record_id only as deterministic tie fallback; reversed caller order, post-correction and two-record live/warm/cold/release parity are tested
identity_binding.active_sites: any empty site iterable (tuple/list/generator) skips memory and matches the base; nonempty lists/generators are normalized to tuples
identity_binding.lineage_bound: lineage_json refuses provenance longer than 1024 bytes under the store's default json.dumps(sort_keys=True) form; longest tested correction is 965 bytes
identity_binding.cold_failure: cold staging catches Exception only (KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit propagate), charges every payload read, returns per-record invalid ids, and persists the typed terminal failure independently of best-effort selective eviction
identity_binding.evidence_fields: workflow uses release_reads_consistent (release-to-release), live_vs_release_exact/logits, control_feature_contract_refused, post-correction live/logit parity and cold_live_parity/cold_logits_parity; old matches_live_slots naming removed

remaining_limitations: random tiny BF16 backbone and synthetic tokenizer; not Spark and not native
full original-parameter hashes are operator-declared in CPU fixtures; native admission must verify them, and should attest the verified content digest to avoid a second backbone hash
the provider refuses adapter content substitution by exact content identity; without an operator attestation the backbone is hashed once at provider construction
the contextual representation release changes after any phi update, so a stale durable batch is refused; this is stricter than producer-output validity alone and is the declared parity boundary
no matched two-group v12 reader in these five modules; the separate matched-reader successor wraps the real path
pre-MLP fusion and 23/31 reader site sets are not measured
the separate native packet is prepared but unreviewed, unsealed and unlaunched; no authorization receipt exists
native uninterrupted-update equivalence is not measured; only the CPU fixture comparison exists
a tokenizer whose behaviour changes without changing identity() is outside the runtime guard
the v5 work ledger currently receives source work only; complete native accounting must be extended before a native claim

producer-side X12 coverage closes control/feature-contract enforcement, pre-existing buffer mutation, publication pointer/manifest failure, whole-release eviction and post-correction parity; high-exposure control-cost charging and P pointer authority/failure handling remain with the density/successor owners

canonical_sha256 is a whole-record digest, not a per-slice digest; the token/feature caches bind the actual slice text digest separately, so a synthetic span with a mismatched canonical hash is tokenized by its real text rather than rejected

preservation.delivery_hashes_basis: working-tree bytes at handoff; main must commit the five producer modules, fixture, tests, script and this report, then re-pin any closure/packet to committed blobs
